findings.location: Scope; Assumptions and constraints; Increment A
findings.problem: The plan adds per-task model selection and a `--model NAME` per-run override, even though the `cards#card-stage` candidate explicitly places “choosing between models” outside its boundary. The plan acknowledges this expansion but supplies no accepted direction that supersedes the roadmap.
findings.suggestion: Remove task routing and the override from this plan, or update the roadmap/candidate through the required direction change before relying on this plan.

findings.problem: The plan explicitly excludes `process` making cards and requires an owner command, but the `card` spec's agreed behavior says a card is made when a book is filed. This leaves the agreed automatic filing behavior unimplemented without recording a superseding decision.
findings.suggestion: Either include the filing/process integration or amend the governing spec/decision to establish the staged manual-card behavior.

findings.location: Scope; Increment C, steps 5–6; Completion criterion 5
findings.problem: The delimiter safeguard is specified only for a piece of book text. The card job also receives source-derived title and outline, plus untrusted model-written notes, but the plan does not require those inputs to be separately delimited and labeled as data. Thus the claimed guarantee that book text never reaches a model outside unforgeable delimiters is not planned for every card-job input.
findings.suggestion: Specify prompt construction for every untrusted/source-derived card-job input, with per-call unforgeable delimiters and tests covering hostile titles, headings, and note text.

findings.problem: The plan omits two agreed card behaviors in `docs/specs/card.md`: cards must be written in English regardless of source language, and short/pointer-only items below a configurable cutoff receive metadata-only partial cards. A one-piece converted item instead always receives a model card, and no cutoff or language requirement is planned.
findings.suggestion: Add the language and configurable small-item/pointer-only paths, with acceptance tests; alternatively record an approved spec change that defers them.

findings.problem: `--model NAME` makes a registry entry selectable through a command-line argument. The referenced models specification says the registry and its entries are owner-only configuration and are never an argument; this also bypasses the plan's stated task-setting-only selection model.
findings.suggestion: Remove the command-line entry override, or obtain and record a governing-spec change that permits this limited override and defines its authorization and audit behavior.

summary: The plan has material scope and behavior drift from its roadmap candidate and governing card/model specifications, plus an incomplete prompt-boundary safeguard.
